title: A sheaf whose finite direct image on a curve is constructible is constructible
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $X$ and $Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$ of dimension at most one, let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism of $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ whose direct image $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is torsion, so that $(X,F)$ and $(Y,f_*F)$ are curve coefficient pairs [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. If $f_*F$ is constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion], then $F$ is constructible.

source.place: Etale Cohomology: the converse of Lemma 095R (lemma-finite-pushforward-constructible), needed for the assertions (4), (5) of Lemma 0A5D ('those statements that apply', Section 03SB, list after Situation 03SB) for f_*F. Intended proof: the counit f^{-1}f_*F -> F is surjective (on stalks it is the projection of the finite stalk formula, lemma-weil-pbc-finite-stalk-formula, onto the factor of the given point), f^{-1}f_*F is constructible (Lemma 095G, lemma-pullback-constructible), and a quotient of a constructible abelian sheaf on a Noetherian scheme is constructible (Proposition 09BH, proposition-constructible-over-noetherian (2)). Not stated in Stacks; the composition of these three is the agent's.

proof.text: Apply CurveCoefficientPair.finite_pushforward_data to obtain Fmid and K, their torsion proofs, constructibility of Fmid and a short exact sequence K → Fmid → P.F.

Form the curve coefficient pair Q on the same curve with sheaf Fmid. Apply CurveCoefficientPair.constructible_sub_quotient Q to this short exact sequence and take its quotient clause. Definitionally the resulting quotient pair is P, so P.IsConstructible follows.

Proof in six steps along the intended route of the source field: (1) notation, X Noetherian (elementary); (2) the counit f^{-1}f_*F -> F is surjective on every geometric stalk: its stalk is the restriction of germs r composed with the inverse-image stalk iso (new node lem-weil-pbc-counit-stalk-germ-restriction, any morphism; Lean slopmaster2 Etale.stalkRestrict_eq_counit, sorry-free), and for finite f the r's over a geometric point assemble to the finite stalk formula iso (new node lem-weil-pbc-finite-stalk-formula-restriction, the explicit form of the closed lemma-weil-pbc-finite-stalk-formula; Lean Etale.isIso_piLift_stalkRestrict, sorry-free); (3) epimorphism: cokernel zero on a covering family of stalks, via prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact and the Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-detect-mono (as in the sibling); (4) f^{-1}f_*F constructible in the curve sense, following Stacks 095G's proof directly in the curve sense with the closed nodes lemma-constructible-pullback-stratification, lemma-constructible-pullback-locally-constant, lemma-constructible-iso-invariance, lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar and lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition (strata constructible because X is Noetherian), plus torsion via lem-weil-pbc-torsion-sheaf-characterizations; prop-constructible-pullback (closed) was not cited directly because its finiteness clause (def-constructible-finite) quantifies over separably closed geometric points while the curve definition uses algebraically closed ones; (5) the kernel is torsion; (6) the reviewed sibling lem-weil-pbc-curve-constructible-sub-quotient (Stacks 09BH (2)) gives F constructible as the quotient.
